incident_text: WhatsApp replies are arriving late for many users, and some never arrive. Started around 09:00.

truth.description: A msg-delivery release leaks memory, causing out-of-memory kills, a consumer crash loop and queue rebalancing, so outbound messages lag.

logs.msg: memory usage {memory_pct}% of limit, gc pressure high
worker killed: out of memory, restarting consumer
consumer cancelled: channel closed by msg-delivery, rebalancing consumers

changes.note: batch size increase for delivery receipts

trap: queue lag looks like a producer burst; the real cause is a consumer crash loop after a leaky release
